title: All subsets of a set
summary: For every snack ask one question, in the basket or not; every path through those questions is one possible basket.

mapping.story: In or out, for each snack
mapping.formal: Choose or skip at each index

examples.label: Three snacks
examples.explanation: Two choices for each of three snacks: 8 baskets.

ladder.name: Count through every on/off pattern
ladder.idea: Number the baskets 0 to 2ⁿ − 1; in binary, each bit says whether a snack is in. Build the basket for every number.

ladder.name: Choose or skip, then undo
ladder.idea: Walk the snacks in order. For each, explore the baskets that include it, take it back out, and explore the baskets without it.
ladder.insight: There are 2ⁿ baskets to write out, so no method beats O(n · 2ⁿ). Building baskets one choice at a time shares the work between them and is the shape every backtracking problem reuses.

transfer.problem: List every way to choose toppings for a pizza from a menu of toppings, including no toppings.
transfer.explanation: Each topping is either chosen or not: the choose-or-skip search lists every combination.

selfCheck: Records a copy of the basket, not the basket itself.
Undoes each choice after exploring it.
Produces 2ⁿ baskets, including the empty one.
